title: GDPR: Possibility to set the iframe youtube domain to https://www.youtube-nocookie.com
body:
(https://www.ghacks.net/2018/05/23/why-you-should-always-use-youtubes-privacy-enhanced-mode/)

### Motivation

Due to GDPR Cookie law is necessary to remove analytical cookies that youtube iframe uses when you the iframe domain is not https://www.youtube-nocookie.com.
The solution could be implement an option to use the youtube iframe whit **nocookie domain** and others necessary params:
_<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/CiXNIjGX1hY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>_

instead of:
_<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/CiXNIjGX1hY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>_
author: Participant 1
